job.name: ig39_cover
job.person_note: The SAME man as in the attached photo: same face, short silver hair, navy blazer, white shirt; do not change his face shape.
job.style: A finished, minimal, eye-catching vertical Instagram Reels COVER, cinematic dark podcast studio photo with bold typography. Bold, clean, perfectly spelled Russian typography is REQUIRED. No logos, no watermarks, no UI elements.
job.style_qa: обложка: тот же седой мужчина в тёмной студии подкаста; надписи «НАСТРОЙ НА ВСЮ ЖИЗНЬ:» и «Я НЕПОБЕДИМ» без ошибок, других слов и логотипов нет
job.prompt: Vertical 9:16 cover. The man from the reference sits in a dark moody podcast studio, a calm knowing half-smile, looking into the camera, warm rim light; his head and shoulders fill the UPPER half of the frame (face between 14% and 42% of the image height), face fully visible and NOT covered by text. Below him the frame is dark (his dark blazer and the black studio). In the lower-middle part, between 50% and 72% of the image height: a small white uppercase line «НАСТРОЙ НА ВСЮ ЖИЗНЬ:» and under it a huge bold golden-yellow condensed uppercase title «Я НЕПОБЕДИМ» across almost the full width. No other text.
